subject: Banking
title: Reserve Requirements
description: A short lesson to help you apply Reserve Requirements.

hook.text: Banks used to be required to keep 10% of deposits in reserve. In 2020, the Fed dropped that requirement to zero.

buildup.text: Reserve requirements limit how much banks can lend. Higher reserves mean less lending.

discovery.text: With zero reserves required, banks can theoretically lend every dollar deposited.

twist.text: China's central bank actively uses reserve ratios. It adjusts them to control lending in ways the Fed no longer does.

climax.text: Reserve requirements were banking's oldest control lever.

punchline.text: Reserve requirement: zero. The Fed now uses other tools to control banks.

quiz.question: What is the current US bank reserve requirement?
